sloka: क्षुधा चैव सहस्राक्षम् ब्रह्म हत्या सम् आविशत् ।तम् इन्द्रम् मलिनम् देवा ऋषयः च तपोधनाः ॥१-२४-१९॥
transliteration: kṣudhā caiva sahasrākṣam brahma hatyā sam āviśat ।tam indram malinam devā ṛṣayaḥ ca tapodhanāḥ ॥1-24-19॥

translations.english: Devas and rishis endowed with the wealth of asceticism bathed Indra with the (consecrated) waters (brought from all rivers) from the pitchers and got him cleansed of impurities.
